armyRule.body:
If your Army Faction is GENESTEALER CULTS, you start the battle with a number of Resurgence points, depending on the battle size, as shown below:
▪ **Incursion:** 6 Resurgence points.
▪ **Strike Force:** 10 Resurgence points.
▪ **Onslaught:** 14 Resurgence points.

Each time a unit from your army is destroyed, if every model (excluding CHARACTER models) in that unit has this ability, you can spend the relevant number of Resurgence points shown below based on that unit's Starting Strength (not including attached CHARACTER models):
▪ **Aberrants:** 5 models — 4 Resurgence points; 10 models — 8 Resurgence points.
▪ **Acolyte Hybrids with Autopistols, Acolyte Hybrids with Hand Flamers, Hybrid Metamorphs:** 5 models — 2 Resurgence points; 10 models — 4 Resurgence points.
▪ **Atalan Jackals:** 5 models — 2 Resurgence points; 10 models — 6 Resurgence points.
▪ **Neophyte Hybrids:** 10 models — 3 Resurgence points; 20 models — 6 Resurgence points.
▪ **Purestrain Genestealers:** 5 models — 2 Resurgence points; 10 models — 6 Resurgence points.

If you do:
▪ Add a new unit to your army identical to your destroyed unit (excluding CHARACTER models), in Cult Ambush, at its Starting Strength, with all of its wounds remaining and any [ONE SHOT] weapons those models are equipped with considered as not having been shot.
▪ Place one Cult Ambush marker (see below) anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 9" horizontally away from all enemy units (if this is not possible, no marker is placed).

### Units in Cult Ambush
Cult Ambush is a type of Strategic Reserves. Units in Cult Ambush cannot be targeted with the Rapid Ingress Stratagem, but can be set up on the battlefield using a Cult Ambush marker as described below, or by following the rules for Strategic Reserves in a subsequent turn. Units in Cult Ambush are not automatically destroyed at the end of the third battle round.

### Cult Ambush Markers
Use a circular 32mm diameter marker for Cult Ambush markers. If an enemy model (excluding AIRCRAFT) ends any kind of move within 8" of a Cult Ambush marker you placed, that Cult Ambush marker is removed from the battlefield. At the end of your opponent's next Movement phase, for each of your Cult Ambush markers still on the battlefield, you can select one unit from your army that is in Cult Ambush to make an **[gloss:ingress-move:ingress move]**. For that **ingress move**, set that unit up with at least one model in that unit in base contact with that Cult Ambush marker and all other models placed wholly within 3" of that Cult Ambush marker (that Cult Ambush marker is then removed from the battlefield). Units in Cult Ambush can make an **ingress move** in the first battle round using this rule.
armyRule.flavor: Genestealer Cults keep their fighting strength carefully hidden from their oppressors until the glorious Day of Ascension arrives. When they finally emerge to fight, it is after long years of meticulous planning, and with an intimate knowledge of the battlefield that grants them a tactical advantage. Even as battle rages, reinforcements slip from the shadows or spill up from the dark places below, called to war by the Broodmind.
armyRule.name: Cult Ambush

enhancements.flavor: Though the truth may lie with cocktails of alchemical enzymes or xenos hormones triggering ferocious metabolic renewal, the cult’s masses see this nigh-immortal leader as a vessel of divine favour.
enhancements.name: Mutagenic Regeneration

enhancements.body: ABOMINANT, BIOPHAGUS or PATRIARCH model only. While an enemy unit is within Engagement Range of the bearer’s unit, subtract 1 from the Objective Control characteristic of models in that enemy unit (to a minimum of 1).

In addition, each time such a unit is selected to fight, if it made a Charge move this turn, until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in that unit.
rule.flavor: Little can assuage a Genestealer Cults least Human instincts, behaviours made even more ferocious under provocation. Stimulated by psionic pulses of the Broodmind or fuelled by alchemical concoctions delivered from alien grafts, impulses drive the blessed to acts of increased savagery.

stratagems.effect: Your unit has +2 to Charge rolls.

stratagems.target: One Aberrants, Biophagus or Purestrain Genestealers unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.when: Fight phase.

In addition, it does not need to end that move closer to the closest enemy model, provided it ends it as close as possible to the closest enemy unit.

stratagems.name: Hyper-Metabolic Vigour

stratagems.when: Fight phase.

stratagems.name: Saintly Paroxysm

stratagems.flavor: Face to face with hideous genetic monstrosities, their full horror can shake even the most stoic soul.
stratagems.name: Bio-Horror Revelation
stratagems.target: One Aberrants, Biophagus or Purestrain Genestealers unit from your army.
stratagems.when: Start of your opponent's Shooting phase.

stratagems.effect: You can set up that Cult Ambush marker anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 8" horizontally away from all enemy units.

stratagems.when: Any phase, just after an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of one or more of your Cult Ambush markers, before removing those markers from the battlefield.

enhancements.flavor: Whether through intensive cross-training with tainted officers or some symbiotic neuro-mimicry, this insurrectionist is adept in daring tactical manoeuvres.
enhancements.name: Adaptive Reprisal

enhancements.body: GENESTEALER CULTS INFANTRY model only. Improve the Leadership and Objective Control characteristics of models in the bearer’s unit by 1.
enhancements.flavor: Hidden for years within a xeno-tainted regiment, this feted commander has returned to lead their guerrillas, donning once more the garb of the insurgent. Respected with reverent awe, they instil a disciplined professionalism and focus in their cult comrades.

enhancements.flavor: Taking a righteous vindication in turning the oppressor’s tactics against them, this war leader coordinates their broodkins last-second fire into effective volleys to drive back the foe.
enhancements.name: Fire-point Commander

rule.body:
### Integrated Tactics
Each time an ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army (see below) is selected to shoot, you can select one enemy unit within 18" of and visible to that unit. If you do, until the end of the phase, models in that ASTRA MILITARUM unit can only target that enemy unit (and only if it is an eligible target) and that enemy unit is caught in overlapping fire. While an enemy unit is caught in overlapping fire, each time a GENESTEALER CULTS model from your army targets that enemy unit with a ranged attack, add 1 to the Hit roll.

### BROOD BROTHERS
You can include ASTRA MILITARUM units in your army, even though they do not have the GENESTEALER CULTS Faction keyword. The combined points cost of such units you can include in your army is:
▪ Incursion: Up to 500 pts
▪ Strike Force: Up to 1000 pts
▪ Onslaught: Up to 1500 pts
A GENESTEALER CULTS model must be your WARLORD, and ASTRA MILITARUM models from your army lose the Voice of Command ability if they have it. You cannot include units with any of the following keywords in your army using this rule: AIRCRAFT; COMMISSAR; EPIC HERO; MILITARUM TEMPESTUS; OGRYN; RATLING; TECH-PRIEST ENGINSEER; MINISTORUM PRIEST.
rule.flavor: Coordinating with their militant allies via stolen vox equipment or signalling with cult icons, the insidious broodkin engulfs the hated foe in overlapping fields of fire.
rule.name: Integrated Tactics & BROOD BROTHERS

If it does, after it has resolved those attacks, roll one D6 for each of those GENESTEALER CULTS units: on a 5+, the unit being rolled for suffers D3+1 mortal wounds.
stratagems.flavor: With martial pragmatism and the cult's victory at stake, Brood Brothers will willingly open fire on the foe even if it endangers infiltrating cells of allies.
stratagems.name: Acceptable Losses
stratagems.sublabel: Brood Brother Auxilia – Strategic Ploy Stratagem

stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.

stratagems.flavor: Disciplined salvoes of fire can drive the foe into cover, leaving them vulnerable to the rest of the cult.
stratagems.name: Suppress and Overwhelm
stratagems.sublabel: Brood Brother Auxilia – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.target: That ASTRA MILITARUM unit.
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, just after an ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army has shot.

stratagems.flavor: Xeno-tainted soldiers have long learned to lurk in the shadows, ready to attack when the cult calls.
stratagems.name: Regimental Reinforcements
stratagems.restrictions: You can only use this Stratagem once per battle.
stratagems.sublabel: Brood Brother Auxilia – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.target: That INFANTRY unit. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY REGIMENT unit from your army (excluding Artillery and CHARACTER units) is destroyed.

stratagems.effect: Select one of those Cult Ambush markers. You can set up that Cult Ambush marker anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 8" horizontally away from all enemy units and wholly within 6" of your unit.
stratagems.flavor: Hulking armoured war engines provide ideal cover to launch a well-timed ambush.
stratagems.name: In the Shadow of Iron
stratagems.sublabel: Brood Brother Auxilia – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.target: One ASTRA MILITARUM VEHICLE unit from your army.
stratagems.when: Any phase, just after an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of one or more of your Cult Ambush markers.

enhancements.body: TYRANIDS model only. Each time the bearer would regain one or more lost wounds from the Psionic Parasitism Detachment rule, it regains up to twice that number of lost wounds instead.
enhancements.flavor: Invisible psionic tendrils drift around this bioform’s cranium, stabbing out to force alien demands into fragmenting hybrid minds and suck the bioenergy from them in merciless draughts.
enhancements.name: Synaptic Auger

enhancements.body: GENESTEALER CULTS model only. Enemy units cannot use the Fire Overwatch Stratagem to shoot at the bearer’s unit.
enhancements.flavor: Though hollowing them out like acid, the insidious power of the Hive Mind blazes from this delirious fanatic and forces their enemies to recoil.
enhancements.name: Enraptured Damnation

enhancements.body: Winged Hive Tyrant model only. Improve the Strength and Armour Penetration characteristics of melee weapons equipped by the bearer by 1.
enhancements.flavor: Adapted by the Hive Mind to lead the first invasion swarms, this leader organism’s bioweapons emphasise vicious shock assault and maximum bloodshed.
enhancements.name: Vanguard Tyrant

enhancements.body: GENESTEALER CULTS model only. Weapons equipped by models in the bearer’s unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability while targeting an enemy unit within 6" of one or more friendly TYRANIDS units.
enhancements.flavor: This cult leader’s powerful psyche has withstood Hive Mind integration better than most, at least for now. It even relays a crude approximation of synaptic signals to their underlings. Of course, this only makes them and their followers more selflessly obedient drones.
enhancements.name: Inhuman Integration

rule.body:
At the end of your Movement phase, for each TYRANIDS SYNAPSE unit from your army, you can select one friendly Genestealer Cults unit (excluding Purestrain Genestealer and Patriarch units) and one friendly Tyranids unit each within 9" of and visible to that SYNAPSE unit. If you do, that GENESTEALER CULTS unit from your army suffers D3+1 mortal wounds and one model in the selected TYRANIDS unit regains up to that many lost wounds and until the start of your next Movement phase, each time a model in the selected TYRANIDS unit makes an attack, add 1 to the Hit roll.

TYRANIDS units from your army have the following ability:

**Catalyst (Aura):** While an enemy unit is within 6" of this unit, each time a friendly GENESTEALER CULTS unit makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, add 1 to the Hit roll.
rule.flavor: With each tug on the synaptic leash, the Hive Mind drains more of its hapless worshippers.
rule.name: Psionic Parasitism

stratagems.effect:
▪ Your unit has +1 to **[gloss:charge-roll:Charge rolls]**.
▪ You can use this part of this **[gloss:stratagem:Stratagem]**. If you do:
▪ Your unit can re-roll **Charge rolls**.
▪ Your unit __must__ end that **[gloss:charge-move:charge move]** engaged with an enemy unit engaged with that friendly TYRANIDS unit.
stratagems.flavor: Cultists dash madly into the fighting without a care for their survival, drawn onward to aid the vanguard organisms by a will they cannot resist.
stratagems.name: Divine Imperative
stratagems.target: That GENESTEALER CULTS unit.
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase, when a friendly GENESTEALER CULTS unit within 12" of a friendly engaged TYRANIDS unit **[gloss:declare-charge:declares a charge]**.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets an enemy unit, re-roll a Wound roll of 1. If one or more friendly TYRANIDS units are within 6" of that enemy unit, you can re-roll the Wound roll instead.
stratagems.flavor: Goaded by the newly ascendant Hive Mind, the cultists fight with greater fury even as their muscles tear and organs rupture under the strain.
stratagems.name: Hyperferocity
stratagems.target: One GENESTEALER CULTS unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.when: Fight phase.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the battle, each time a GENESTEALER CULTS model from your army makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, add 1 to the Hit roll and add 1 to the Wound roll.
stratagems.flavor: Some amongst the cult still retain enough sentience and zeal to feel rage and a need for vengeance if they see the Star Children slain.
stratagems.name: Avenge the Star Children
stratagems.target: One TYRANIDS CHARACTER unit from your army that was destroyed by that enemy unit this phase. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has shot or fought.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.
stratagems.flavor: Like predatory sea beasts lunging from wheeling shoals of fish, the vanguard organisms strike and fade from amidst the cultist hordes repeatedly, picking apart their overwhelmed prey.
stratagems.name: Darting Attacks
stratagems.target: One TYRANIDS unit from your army.
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or your Charge phase.

stratagems.effect: Until the start of your next Command phase, increase the range of your unit’s Catalyst ability by 3.
stratagems.flavor: As the Tyranid invasion gathers pace, the influence of the Hive Mind surges like waves rolling ever higher onto a desolate shore.
stratagems.name: Psi Surge
stratagems.restrictions: Each time you use this Stratagem, until the end of your next Command phase, you cannot use this Stratagem again.

stratagems.when: Start of any phase.

stratagems.effect: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.
stratagems.flavor: Never again will the tunnel networks of the cult provide secret roads for hopeful and idealistic freedom fighters. Yet they can still serve one last time as a means by which the Tyranids and their surviving worshippers can vanish from the battlefield only to strike again elsewhere.
stratagems.name: Resistance Tunnels

stratagems.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.

enhancements.flavor: No matter how often the oppressors seek to trap or silence this leader, they always find themselves left empty-handed and foolish, their elusive quarry long gone.
enhancements.name: Prowling Agitant

enhancements.name: Our Time Is Nigh

enhancements.body: GENESTEALER CULTS model only. Each time a model in the bearer’s unit makes an attack that targets a CHARACTER unit, add 1 to the Hit roll
enhancements.flavor: With an impulse of the Broodmind pulsing in their brain, this holy avenger stalks the battlefield, seeking to slay generals, preachers and all those the foe looks to for salvation and inspiration.
enhancements.name: Assassination Edict

rule.flavor: The insidious broodkin of the cult lurk hidden within the shadows, tirelessly tracking their enemies as predatory beasts stalk their prey. Only when their position is perfect do they strike. Worming into the fight from hidden tunnels, ducts and sewers, they rise to engulf their victims in a hail of unexpected firepower and a flurry of stabbing blades and raking talons.

enhancements.flavor: With a chilling focus enabling them to identify ideal firing positions at a glance, this frontier assassin leads their brood in a coiling evasion from their enemies that suddenly changes into a lunging strike back.
enhancements.name: Serpentine Tactics

enhancements.body: GENESTEALER CULTS model only. While the bearer is embarked within a TRANSPORT, each time that TRANSPORT is selected to shoot, until the end of the phase, improve the Ballistic Skill characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by that TRANSPORT as a result of the Firing Deck ability by 1.
enhancements.flavor: This parasitic, cybernetic implant allows its host to tap into the survey augurs and proximity detectors of the cults industrial transports. They use this leeched data to guide their comrades’ fire from vision slits and hatches, even at high speed.
enhancements.name: Cartographic Data-leech

enhancements.body: GENESTEALER CULTS MOUNTED model only. In your Shooting phase, after the bearer has shot, select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks made with a cult sniper rifle. Until the start of your next Shooting phase, each time a model in that enemy unit makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
enhancements.flavor: When they hit, these hand-crafted sniper bullets radiate with a supernatural aura redolent of the void’s numbing chill. Muscles seize, fingers cramp and thought slows as the sinister saturation takes effect.
enhancements.name: Starfall Shells

enhancements.body: GENESTEALER CULTS model only. Each time a model in the bearer’s unit makes a ranged attack, if it disembarked from a TRANSPORT this turn, you can re-roll the Hit roll.
enhancements.flavor: An expert in rapid attacks from speeding vehicles, this veteran has drilled their insurrectionist cell, readying them to leap into the fray with stolen weapons blazing.
enhancements.name: Assault Commando

rule.body: While a GENESTEALER CULTS MOUNTED/VEHICLE model from your army is not Battle-shocked, add 1 to its **[gloss:objective:Objective]** Control characteristic. In addition, at the end of your Command phase, if one or more Atalan Jackals units from your army are within range of an **objective** you control, that **objective** remains under your control until your opponent’s Level of Control over that **objective** marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.
rule.flavor: Whether forming loose clans of wandering nomads or militarised rapid-reaction corps, the cultists of Outlander Claws use their experience to launch assaults on prominent targets. Swiftly exploiting or rigging them with proximity charges, they can deny resources to the enemy without yoking themselves to a static defence.
rule.name: Rapid Takeover

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.
stratagems.flavor: With evasive manoeuvres and split-second repairs, Outlander Claws marshal their rugged vehicles through the worst the foe can throw at them.
stratagems.name: Devoted Crew
stratagems.target: One Goliath Rockgrinder or Goliath Truck unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.
stratagems.flavor: Serpent-fast, jinking and swerving with incredible skill, the cult’s light vehicles appear to slide through the oppressors' gunfire.
stratagems.name: Deft Manoeuvring
stratagems.target: One Achilles Ridgerunners or Atalan Jackals unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [LETHAL HITS] ability while targeting an enemy unit within 18".
stratagems.flavor: A cult’s experienced outriders are experts in hit-and-run attacks and close-range firefights. These skills are deadly when combined.
stratagems.name: Close-Range Shoot-Out
stratagems.target: One GENESTEALER CULTS MOUNTED or GENESTEALER CULTS VEHICLE unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.

stratagems.effect: You can set up that Cult Ambush marker anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 8" horizontally away from all enemy units.
stratagems.flavor: With raw speed and subtle misdirection, Atalan Jackals outflank those who believe them trapped.
stratagems.name: Along Shadowed Trails
stratagems.target: Select one of those Cult Ambush markers.
stratagems.when: Any phase, just after an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of one or more of your Cult Ambush markers.

stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".
stratagems.flavor: An Outlander Claw’s skilled riders and crews can use their enhanced hybrid reactions to rapidly alter speed and course, roaring after fleeing prey or luring enemy out of position and leaving them flat-footed.
stratagems.name: Rapid Feint
stratagems.target: One Achilles Ridgerunners or Atalan Jackals unit from your army that is within 8" of that enemy unit.
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.

stratagems.effect: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.
stratagems.flavor: Skirting the edge of battle, an Outlander Claw's raiders watch keenly forvulnerabilities, ready to throw themselves back into the fight to exploit any weaknesses in the enemy.

stratagems.target: One GENESTEALER CULTS MOUNTED or GENESTEALER CULTS VEHICLE unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units and is wholly within 9" of one or more battlefield edges.
stratagems.when: End of your opponent's Fight phase.

enhancements.flavor: This war leader carries a gift from their Patriarch: a talismanic shard of a chitinous claw, a vial of the liquid that seeps into the genesis pools or a psionic growth within the chosen one’s brain. Its form matters less than its effect, for it radiates an inspirational wave of the Broodmind that focuses the minds of the faithful on their duties to the cult above all else.

enhancements.body: MAGUS, PRIMUS or ACOLYTE ICONWARD model only. Each time a model in the bearer’s unit makes an attack that targets a CHARACTER unit, add 1 to the Hit roll and add 1 to the Wound roll.
enhancements.flavor: With vitriol and passion do the cult’s leaders castigate the foe’s champions, casting them as the most hated architects of oppression and inciting their comrades to murderous intent.
enhancements.name: Denunciator of Tyrants

enhancements.body: Magus, Primus or Acolyte Iconward model only. You start the battle with 2 additional Resurgence points.
enhancements.flavor: This agent of the Star Children is a living legend known amongst the entire cult. Their reputation as a spiritual orator, undefeated liberator or sanctified warden is mythic, and their very presence draws the faithful to their side for a chance to fight alongside them.

enhancements.flavor: This insurgent is a font of aggressive encouragement. As some supernatural vitality their broodkin feel in their souls, the leader’s words and deeds rouse them with fresh energy and stir them to charge forth in blind fury.

The masses draw upon energy reserves in their desire to heed their masters’ wishes, surging selflessly into the fray, ready to hurl themselves in harm’s way for the Patriarch’s chosen.

stratagems.flavor: The faithful will gladly hurl themselves into harm's way.frenziedly dragging the foe down.
stratagems.name: Frenzied Devotion

stratagems.name: Vengeance for the Martyr!

stratagems.flavor: Owing to their hypersensory reactions, the cult’s rate of fire increases.

stratagems.flavor: When the cult's leaders demand devotion, danger and exhaustion are forgotten in the rush to serve.

stratagems.flavor: Bloody persecution by the oppressors is grist for the mill of the cult's violent and zealous creed.
stratagems.name: The Path of Anguish

PURESTRAIN GENESTEALERS unit only. This unit has:

enhancements.flavor: Spontaneous biomorphs amongst this brood of Purestrains render them bigger, stronger, and mark them out as surely being the chosen of the Star Children themselves.

enhancements.flavor: The broodmind bond between this Patriarch and its Purestrain spawn is so strong that it can virtually wield them like its own vicious talons.

rule.flavor: Genestealers on the hunt combine malevolent cunning and inhuman agility to strike and fade again and again, until their prey are reduced to panicked disarray.

stratagems.flavor: Purestrain Genestealers think and move with horrifying swiftness, darting through the smoke and shadow of the battlefield, remaining always a few steps ahead of their prey.

enhancements.flavor: Fighting under the eyes of the very leaders of their cult, the faithful are gripped by an unwavering determination to excel in battle.

armyRule.body:
If your Army Faction is GENESTEALER CULTS, you start the battle with a number of Resurgence points, depending on the battle size, as shown below:
▪ **Incursion:** 6 Resurgence points.
▪ **Strike Force:** 10 Resurgence points.
▪ **Onslaught:** 14 Resurgence points.

Each time a unit from your army is destroyed, if every model (excluding CHARACTER models) in that unit has this ability, you can spend the relevant number of Resurgence points shown below based on that unit's Starting Strength (not including attached CHARACTER models):
▪ **Aberrants:** 5 models — 4 Resurgence points; 10 models — 8 Resurgence points.
▪ **Acolyte Hybrids with Autopistols, Acolyte Hybrids with Hand Flamers, Hybrid Metamorphs:** 5 models — 2 Resurgence points; 10 models — 4 Resurgence points.
▪ **Atalan Jackals:** 5 models — 2 Resurgence points; 10 models — 6 Resurgence points.
▪ **Neophyte Hybrids:** 10 models — 3 Resurgence points; 20 models — 6 Resurgence points.
▪ **Purestrain Genestealers:** 5 models — 2 Resurgence points; 10 models — 6 Resurgence points.

If you do:
▪ Add a new unit to your army identical to your destroyed unit (excluding CHARACTER models), in Cult Ambush, at its Starting Strength, with all of its wounds remaining and any [ONE SHOT] weapons those models are equipped with considered as not having been shot.
▪ Place one Cult Ambush marker (see below) anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 9" horizontally away from all enemy units (if this is not possible, no marker is placed).

### Units in Cult Ambush
Cult Ambush is a type of Strategic Reserves. Units in Cult Ambush cannot be targeted with the Rapid Ingress Stratagem, but can be set up on the battlefield using a Cult Ambush marker as described below, or by following the rules for Strategic Reserves in a subsequent turn. Units in Cult Ambush are not automatically destroyed at the end of the third battle round.

### Cult Ambush Markers
Use a circular 32mm diameter marker for Cult Ambush markers. If an enemy model (excluding AIRCRAFT) ends any kind of move within 8" of a Cult Ambush marker you placed, that Cult Ambush marker is removed from the battlefield. At the end of your opponent's next Movement phase, for each of your Cult Ambush markers still on the battlefield, you can select one unit from your army that is in Cult Ambush to make an **[gloss:ingress-move:ingress move]**. For that **ingress move**, set that unit up with at least one model in that unit in base contact with that Cult Ambush marker and all other models placed wholly within 3" of that Cult Ambush marker (that Cult Ambush marker is then removed from the battlefield). Units in Cult Ambush can make an **ingress move** in the first battle round using this rule.
armyRule.flavor: Genestealer Cults keep their fighting strength carefully hidden from their oppressors until the glorious Day of Ascension arrives. When they finally emerge to fight, it is after long years of meticulous planning, and with an intimate knowledge of the battlefield that grants them a tactical advantage. Even as battle rages, reinforcements slip from the shadows or spill up from the dark places below, called to war by the Broodmind.
armyRule.name: Cult Ambush

stratagems.flavor: Face to face with hideous genetic monstrosities, their full horror can shake even the most stoic soul.
stratagems.name: Bio-Horror Revelation
stratagems.target: One Aberrants, Biophagus or Purestrain Genestealers unit from your army.
stratagems.when: Start of your opponent's Shooting phase.

stratagems.effect: You can set up that Cult Ambush marker anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 8" horizontally away from all enemy units.
stratagems.flavor: Adaptive and intelligent, the purest of a cult's broods can evade their foes to find new avenues of ingress.
stratagems.name: Evasive Vanguard
stratagems.target: Select one of those Cult Ambush markers.
stratagems.when: Any phase, just after an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of one or more of your Cult Ambush markers, before removing those markers from the battlefield.

enhancements.body: GENESTEALER CULTS INFANTRY model only. Once per turn, when a friendly ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY or ASTRA MILITARUM MOUNTED unit within 9" of the bearer is selected to shoot, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, until the end of the phase, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in that unit by 1.
enhancements.flavor: With access to Imperial data-logs and servo-scry records, this cult leader feeds the stolen information to their professional allies, enabling them to immediately exploit weak points in the enemy.
enhancements.name: Martial Espionage

enhancements.body: GENESTEALER CULTS INFANTRY model only. When you target this unit with the **[gloss:heroic-intervention:Heroic Intervention Stratagem]**, that use is -1 CP.
enhancements.flavor: Whether through intensive cross-training with tainted officers or some symbiotic neuro-mimicry, this insurrectionist is adept in daring tactical manoeuvres.
enhancements.name: Adaptive Reprisal

enhancements.body: GENESTEALER CULTS INFANTRY model only. Improve the Leadership and Objective Control characteristics of models in the bearer’s unit by 1.
enhancements.flavor: Hidden for years within a xeno-tainted regiment, this feted commander has returned to lead their guerrillas, donning once more the garb of the insurgent. Respected with reverent awe, they instil a disciplined professionalism and focus in their cult comrades.
enhancements.name: The Hero Returned

enhancements.body: GENESTEALER CULTS INFANTRY model only. Each time you target the bearer’s unit with the Fire Overwatch Stratagem, while resolving that Stratagem, hits are scored on unmodified Hit rolls of 5+.
enhancements.flavor: Taking a righteous vindication in turning the oppressor’s tactics against them, this war leader coordinates their broodkins last-second fire into effective volleys to drive back the foe.
enhancements.name: Fire-point Commander

rule.body:
### Integrated Tactics
Each time an ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army (see below) is selected to shoot, you can select one enemy unit within 18" of and visible to that unit. If you do, until the end of the phase, models in that ASTRA MILITARUM unit can only target that enemy unit (and only if it is an eligible target) and that enemy unit is caught in overlapping fire. While an enemy unit is caught in overlapping fire, each time a GENESTEALER CULTS model from your army targets that enemy unit with a ranged attack, add 1 to the Hit roll.

### BROOD BROTHERS
You can include ASTRA MILITARUM units in your army, even though they do not have the GENESTEALER CULTS Faction keyword. The combined points cost of such units you can include in your army is:
▪ Incursion: Up to 500 pts
▪ Strike Force: Up to 1000 pts
▪ Onslaught: Up to 1500 pts
A GENESTEALER CULTS model must be your WARLORD, and ASTRA MILITARUM models from your army lose the Voice of Command ability if they have it. You cannot include units with any of the following keywords in your army using this rule: AIRCRAFT; COMMISSAR; EPIC HERO; MILITARUM TEMPESTUS; OGRYN; RATLING; TECH-PRIEST ENGINSEER; MINISTORUM PRIEST.
rule.flavor: Coordinating with their militant allies via stolen vox equipment or signalling with cult icons, the insidious broodkin engulfs the hated foe in overlapping fields of fire.
rule.name: Integrated Tactics & BROOD BROTHERS

stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit that is visible to both of those selected units and within range of at least one ranged weapon from each of those units. Until the end of the phase, models in those units can only make attacks that target that enemy unit (and only if it is an eligible target). When doing so, each time such a model makes an attack, re-roll a Wound roll of 1.
stratagems.flavor: As the Broodmind coordinates their timing, martial and insurrectionist comrades target their chosen victims in volleys of mutually supportive firepower.
stratagems.name: Symbiotic Destruction
stratagems.sublabel: Brood Brother Auxilia – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.target: One ASTRA MILITARUM and one GENESTEALER CULTS unit from your army that have not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.

stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".
stratagems.flavor: Forewarned of the enemy's sudden onset by spies in their ranks or by the Brood Brothers' own strategos, the cult’s faithful evade potential catastrophe.
stratagems.name: A Dark Network
stratagems.sublabel: Brood Brother Auxilia – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.target: One ASTRA MILITARUM or GENESTEALER CULTS unit from your army (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) within 12" of that enemy unit.
stratagems.when: Reinforcements step of your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit is set up on the battlefield from Reserves.

stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of one or more GENESTEALER CULTS units from your army. Until the end of the phase, your unit can make ranged attacks that target that enemy unit. If it does, after it has resolved those attacks, roll one D6 for each of those GENESTEALER CULTS units: on a 5+, the unit being rolled for suffers D3+1 mortal wounds.
stratagems.flavor: With martial pragmatism and the cult's victory at stake, Brood Brothers will willingly open fire on the foe even if it endangers infiltrating cells of allies.
stratagems.name: Acceptable Losses
stratagems.sublabel: Brood Brother Auxilia – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.target: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army.
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.

stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. Until the end of the turn, that enemy unit cannot be targeted with the Fire Overwatch Stratagem and each time a GENESTEALER CULTS unit from your army selects that enemy unit as a target of a charge, you can re-roll the Charge roll.
stratagems.flavor: Disciplined salvoes of fire can drive the foe into cover, leaving them vulnerable to the rest of the cult.
stratagems.name: Suppress and Overwhelm
stratagems.sublabel: Brood Brother Auxilia – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.target: That ASTRA MILITARUM unit.
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, just after an ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army has shot.

stratagems.effect: Roll one D6: on a 3+, place one Cult Ambush marker anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 8" horizontally away from all enemy units (if this is not possible, no marker is placed) and add a new unit to your army identical to your destroyed unit, in Cult Ambush, at its Starting Strength, with all of its wounds remaining and any [ONE SHOT] weapons those models are equipped with considered as not having been shot.
stratagems.flavor: Xeno-tainted soldiers have long learned to lurk in the shadows, ready to attack when the cult calls.
stratagems.name: Regimental Reinforcements
stratagems.restrictions: You can only use this Stratagem once per battle.
stratagems.sublabel: Brood Brother Auxilia – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.target: That INFANTRY unit. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY REGIMENT unit from your army (excluding Artillery and CHARACTER units) is destroyed.

stratagems.effect: Select one of those Cult Ambush markers. You can set up that Cult Ambush marker anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 8" horizontally away from all enemy units and wholly within 6" of your unit.
stratagems.flavor: Hulking armoured war engines provide ideal cover to launch a well-timed ambush.
stratagems.name: In the Shadow of Iron
stratagems.sublabel: Brood Brother Auxilia – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.target: One ASTRA MILITARUM VEHICLE unit from your army.
stratagems.when: Any phase, just after an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of one or more of your Cult Ambush markers.

enhancements.body: TYRANIDS model only. Each time the bearer would regain one or more lost wounds from the Psionic Parasitism Detachment rule, it regains up to twice that number of lost wounds instead.
enhancements.flavor: Invisible psionic tendrils drift around this bioform’s cranium, stabbing out to force alien demands into fragmenting hybrid minds and suck the bioenergy from them in merciless draughts.
enhancements.name: Synaptic Auger

enhancements.body: GENESTEALER CULTS model only. Enemy units cannot use the Fire Overwatch Stratagem to shoot at the bearer’s unit.
enhancements.flavor: Though hollowing them out like acid, the insidious power of the Hive Mind blazes from this delirious fanatic and forces their enemies to recoil.
enhancements.name: Enraptured Damnation

enhancements.body: Winged Hive Tyrant model only. Improve the Strength and Armour Penetration characteristics of melee weapons equipped by the bearer by 1.
enhancements.flavor: Adapted by the Hive Mind to lead the first invasion swarms, this leader organism’s bioweapons emphasise vicious shock assault and maximum bloodshed.
enhancements.name: Vanguard Tyrant

enhancements.body: GENESTEALER CULTS model only. Weapons equipped by models in the bearer’s unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability while targeting an enemy unit within 6" of one or more friendly TYRANIDS units.
enhancements.flavor: This cult leader’s powerful psyche has withstood Hive Mind integration better than most, at least for now. It even relays a crude approximation of synaptic signals to their underlings. Of course, this only makes them and their followers more selflessly obedient drones.
enhancements.name: Inhuman Integration

rule.body:
At the end of your Movement phase, for each TYRANIDS SYNAPSE unit from your army, you can select one friendly Genestealer Cults unit (excluding Purestrain Genestealer and Patriarch units) and one friendly Tyranids unit each within 9" of and visible to that SYNAPSE unit. If you do, that GENESTEALER CULTS unit from your army suffers D3+1 mortal wounds and one model in the selected TYRANIDS unit regains up to that many lost wounds and until the start of your next Movement phase, each time a model in the selected TYRANIDS unit makes an attack, add 1 to the Hit roll.

TYRANIDS units from your army have the following ability:

**Catalyst (Aura):** While an enemy unit is within 6" of this unit, each time a friendly GENESTEALER CULTS unit makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, add 1 to the Hit roll.
rule.flavor: With each tug on the synaptic leash, the Hive Mind drains more of its hapless worshippers.
rule.name: Psionic Parasitism

stratagems.effect:
▪ Your unit has +1 to **[gloss:charge-roll:Charge rolls]**.
▪ You can use this part of this **[gloss:stratagem:Stratagem]**. If you do:
▪ Your unit can re-roll **Charge rolls**.
▪ Your unit __must__ end that **[gloss:charge-move:charge move]** engaged with an enemy unit engaged with that friendly TYRANIDS unit.
stratagems.flavor: Cultists dash madly into the fighting without a care for their survival, drawn onward to aid the vanguard organisms by a will they cannot resist.
stratagems.name: Divine Imperative
stratagems.target: That GENESTEALER CULTS unit.
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase, when a friendly GENESTEALER CULTS unit within 12" of a friendly engaged TYRANIDS unit **[gloss:declare-charge:declares a charge]**.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets an enemy unit, re-roll a Wound roll of 1. If one or more friendly TYRANIDS units are within 6" of that enemy unit, you can re-roll the Wound roll instead.
stratagems.flavor: Goaded by the newly ascendant Hive Mind, the cultists fight with greater fury even as their muscles tear and organs rupture under the strain.
stratagems.name: Hyperferocity
stratagems.target: One GENESTEALER CULTS unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.when: Fight phase.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the battle, each time a GENESTEALER CULTS model from your army makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, add 1 to the Hit roll and add 1 to the Wound roll.
stratagems.flavor: Some amongst the cult still retain enough sentience and zeal to feel rage and a need for vengeance if they see the Star Children slain.
stratagems.name: Avenge the Star Children
stratagems.target: One TYRANIDS CHARACTER unit from your army that was destroyed by that enemy unit this phase. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has shot or fought.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.
stratagems.flavor: Like predatory sea beasts lunging from wheeling shoals of fish, the vanguard organisms strike and fade from amidst the cultist hordes repeatedly, picking apart their overwhelmed prey.
stratagems.name: Darting Attacks
stratagems.target: One TYRANIDS unit from your army.
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or your Charge phase.

stratagems.effect: Until the start of your next Command phase, increase the range of your unit’s Catalyst ability by 3.
stratagems.flavor: As the Tyranid invasion gathers pace, the influence of the Hive Mind surges like waves rolling ever higher onto a desolate shore.
stratagems.name: Psi Surge
stratagems.restrictions: Each time you use this Stratagem, until the end of your next Command phase, you cannot use this Stratagem again.
stratagems.target: One TYRANIDS unit from your army.
stratagems.when: Start of any phase.

stratagems.effect: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.
stratagems.flavor: Never again will the tunnel networks of the cult provide secret roads for hopeful and idealistic freedom fighters. Yet they can still serve one last time as a means by which the Tyranids and their surviving worshippers can vanish from the battlefield only to strike again elsewhere.
stratagems.name: Resistance Tunnels
stratagems.target: One GENESTEALER CULTS or TYRANIDS unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.

enhancements.body: GENESTEALER CULTS model only. In your opponent's Movement phase, if an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of this unit, if this unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, this unit can make a Normal move of up to D6".
enhancements.flavor: No matter how often the oppressors seek to trap or silence this leader, they always find themselves left empty-handed and foolish, their elusive quarry long gone.
enhancements.name: Prowling Agitant

enhancements.body: GENESTEALER CULTS model only. Each time the bearer is set up on the battlefield as Reinforcements, until the end of your next Fight phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in the bearer’s unit have the [LETHAL HITS] ability.
enhancements.flavor: Every oppressor has a weak spot. This savant of tactical analysis pinpoints fractured armour plates, exposed cabling or unshielded flesh with a glance and directs the cults fire to shatter the enemy’s greatest assets.
enhancements.name: A Chink in Their Armour

enhancements.body: GENESTEALER CULTS model only. Once per battle, when the bearer’s unit declares a charge, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, until the end of the phase, add 2 to Charge rolls made for the bearer’s unit.
enhancements.flavor: Infused with transcendent zeal, this insurrectionist and their chosen cultists are assured by telepathic whispers that they are the Star Childrens avatars and that now is the moment to strike.
enhancements.name: Our Time Is Nigh

enhancements.body: GENESTEALER CULTS model only. Each time a model in the bearer’s unit makes an attack that targets a CHARACTER unit, add 1 to the Hit roll
enhancements.flavor: With an impulse of the Broodmind pulsing in their brain, this holy avenger stalks the battlefield, seeking to slay generals, preachers and all those the foe looks to for salvation and inspiration.
enhancements.name: Assassination Edict

rule.body: Each time a GENESTEALER CULTS unit from your army is set up on the battlefield as Reinforcements, until the end of your next Fight phase, weapons equipped by models in that unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] and [IGNORES COVER] abilities.
rule.flavor: The insidious broodkin of the cult lurk hidden within the shadows, tirelessly tracking their enemies as predatory beasts stalk their prey. Only when their position is perfect do they strike. Worming into the fight from hidden tunnels, ducts and sewers, they rise to engulf their victims in a hail of unexpected firepower and a flurry of stabbing blades and raking talons.
rule.name: A Perfect Ambush

stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit (if this Stratagem is used in the Fight phase, that enemy unit must be within Engagement Range of both of your units). Until the end of the phase, each time a model in either of your units makes an attack, it can only target that enemy unit (and only if it is an eligible target for that attack), and when resolving that attack, add 1 to the Wound roll.
stratagems.flavor: A tenet of guerrilla warfare is the concentration of even inferior firepower to inflict maximum harm.
stratagems.name: Coordinated Trap
stratagems.sublabel: Host of Ascension – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.target: Two GENESTEALER CULTS units from your army that have not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.when: The start of your Shooting phase or the start of the Fight phase.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, a Critical Hit is scored on an unmodified Hit roll of 5+, instead of only a 6.
stratagems.flavor: The broodkin have been trained and equipped for this moment, with weapons readied for Ascension.
stratagems.name: Primed and Readied
stratagems.sublabel: Host of Ascension – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.target: One GENESTEALER CULTS units from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.

stratagems.effect: Your unit can be set up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy units.
stratagems.flavor: The cult can expertly assail seemingly impregnable enemy positions.
stratagems.name: Tunnel Crawlers
stratagems.restrictions: A unit targeted by this Stratagem is not eligible to declare a charge in the same turn.
stratagems.sublabel: Host of Ascension – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.target: One GENESTEALER CULTS unit from your army that is arriving using the Deep Strike ability this phase.
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.

stratagems.effect: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.
stratagems.flavor: With their task of drawing the oppressors' fire complete, the surviving cultists melt away, ready to strike again.
stratagems.name: Return to the Shadows
stratagems.sublabel: Host of Ascension – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.target: One GENESTEALER CULTS INFANTRY unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, when setting your unit up using a Cult Ambush marker, set your unit up anywhere on the battlefield wholly within 6" of that Cult Ambush marker and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.flavor: The brood lurks invisibly as the enemy approaches. Not until the last second do they burst from cover to strike.
stratagems.name: Lying in Wait
stratagems.sublabel: Host of Ascension – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.target: One GENESTEALER CULTS BATTLELINE unit from your army in Cult Ambush.
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase.

stratagems.effect: Roll one D6: on a 2-4, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds; on a 5+, that enemy unit suffers 3 mortal wounds.
stratagems.flavor: An enemy's fervour to strike down the faithful of the cult can be turned against them, luring the foe into a region laced with hidden traps and primed explosives.
stratagems.name: A Deadly Snare
stratagems.sublabel: Host of Ascension – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.target: One GENESTEALER CULTS INFANTRY unit from your army that was selected as a target of that charge.
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Charge phase, just after an enemy unit declares a charge.

enhancements.body: GENESTEALER CULTS MOUNTED model only. The bearer’s unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Fell Back.
enhancements.flavor: With a chilling focus enabling them to identify ideal firing positions at a glance, this frontier assassin leads their brood in a coiling evasion from their enemies that suddenly changes into a lunging strike back.
enhancements.name: Serpentine Tactics

enhancements.body: GENESTEALER CULTS model only. While the bearer is embarked within a TRANSPORT, each time that TRANSPORT is selected to shoot, until the end of the phase, improve the Ballistic Skill characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by that TRANSPORT as a result of the Firing Deck ability by 1.
enhancements.flavor: This parasitic, cybernetic implant allows its host to tap into the survey augurs and proximity detectors of the cults industrial transports. They use this leeched data to guide their comrades’ fire from vision slits and hatches, even at high speed.
enhancements.name: Cartographic Data-leech

enhancements.body: GENESTEALER CULTS MOUNTED model only. In your Shooting phase, after the bearer has shot, select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks made with a cult sniper rifle. Until the start of your next Shooting phase, each time a model in that enemy unit makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
enhancements.flavor: When they hit, these hand-crafted sniper bullets radiate with a supernatural aura redolent of the void’s numbing chill. Muscles seize, fingers cramp and thought slows as the sinister saturation takes effect.
enhancements.name: Starfall Shells

enhancements.body: GENESTEALER CULTS model only. Each time a model in the bearer’s unit makes a ranged attack, if it disembarked from a TRANSPORT this turn, you can re-roll the Hit roll.
enhancements.flavor: An expert in rapid attacks from speeding vehicles, this veteran has drilled their insurrectionist cell, readying them to leap into the fray with stolen weapons blazing.
enhancements.name: Assault Commando

rule.body: While a GENESTEALER CULTS MOUNTED/VEHICLE model from your army is not Battle-shocked, add 1 to its **[gloss:objective:Objective]** Control characteristic. In addition, at the end of your Command phase, if one or more Atalan Jackals units from your army are within range of an **objective** you control, that **objective** remains under your control until your opponent’s Level of Control over that **objective** marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.
rule.flavor: Whether forming loose clans of wandering nomads or militarised rapid-reaction corps, the cultists of Outlander Claws use their experience to launch assaults on prominent targets. Swiftly exploiting or rigging them with proximity charges, they can deny resources to the enemy without yoking themselves to a static defence.
rule.name: Rapid Takeover

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.
stratagems.flavor: With evasive manoeuvres and split-second repairs, Outlander Claws marshal their rugged vehicles through the worst the foe can throw at them.
stratagems.name: Devoted Crew
stratagems.target: One Goliath Rockgrinder or Goliath Truck unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.
stratagems.flavor: Serpent-fast, jinking and swerving with incredible skill, the cult’s light vehicles appear to slide through the oppressors' gunfire.
stratagems.name: Deft Manoeuvring
stratagems.target: One Achilles Ridgerunners or Atalan Jackals unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [LETHAL HITS] ability while targeting an enemy unit within 18".
stratagems.flavor: A cult’s experienced outriders are experts in hit-and-run attacks and close-range firefights. These skills are deadly when combined.
stratagems.name: Close-Range Shoot-Out
stratagems.target: One GENESTEALER CULTS MOUNTED or GENESTEALER CULTS VEHICLE unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.

stratagems.effect: You can set up that Cult Ambush marker anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 8" horizontally away from all enemy units.
stratagems.flavor: With raw speed and subtle misdirection, Atalan Jackals outflank those who believe them trapped.
stratagems.name: Along Shadowed Trails
stratagems.target: Select one of those Cult Ambush markers.
stratagems.when: Any phase, just after an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of one or more of your Cult Ambush markers.

stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".
stratagems.flavor: An Outlander Claw’s skilled riders and crews can use their enhanced hybrid reactions to rapidly alter speed and course, roaring after fleeing prey or luring enemy out of position and leaving them flat-footed.
stratagems.name: Rapid Feint
stratagems.target: One Achilles Ridgerunners or Atalan Jackals unit from your army that is within 8" of that enemy unit.
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.

stratagems.effect: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.
stratagems.flavor: Skirting the edge of battle, an Outlander Claw's raiders watch keenly forvulnerabilities, ready to throw themselves back into the fight to exploit any weaknesses in the enemy.
stratagems.name: Encircling the Prey
stratagems.target: One GENESTEALER CULTS MOUNTED or GENESTEALER CULTS VEHICLE unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units and is wholly within 9" of one or more battlefield edges.
stratagems.when: End of your opponent's Fight phase.

enhancements.body: MAGUS, PRIMUS or ACOLYTE ICONWARD model only. You can re-roll Battle-shock tests taken for the bearer’s unit.
enhancements.flavor: This war leader carries a gift from their Patriarch: a talismanic shard of a chitinous claw, a vial of the liquid that seeps into the genesis pools or a psionic growth within the chosen one’s brain. Its form matters less than its effect, for it radiates an inspirational wave of the Broodmind that focuses the minds of the faithful on their duties to the cult above all else.
enhancements.name: Gene-sire’s Reliquant

enhancements.body: MAGUS, PRIMUS or ACOLYTE ICONWARD model only. Each time a model in the bearer’s unit makes an attack that targets a CHARACTER unit, add 1 to the Hit roll and add 1 to the Wound roll.
enhancements.flavor: With vitriol and passion do the cult’s leaders castigate the foe’s champions, casting them as the most hated architects of oppression and inciting their comrades to murderous intent.
enhancements.name: Denunciator of Tyrants

enhancements.body: Magus, Primus or Acolyte Iconward model only. You start the battle with 2 additional Resurgence points.
enhancements.flavor: This agent of the Star Children is a living legend known amongst the entire cult. Their reputation as a spiritual orator, undefeated liberator or sanctified warden is mythic, and their very presence draws the faithful to their side for a chance to fight alongside them.
enhancements.name: Deeds That Speak to the Masses

enhancements.body: MAGUS, PRIMUS or ACOLYTE ICONWARD model only. The bearer’s unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.
enhancements.flavor: This insurgent is a font of aggressive encouragement. As some supernatural vitality their broodkin feel in their souls, the leader’s words and deeds rouse them with fresh energy and stir them to charge forth in blind fury.
enhancements.name: Incendiary Inspiration

rule.body: For each ACOLYTE HybRIDS, HybRID METAMORPHS and NEOPHYTE HybRIDS unit from your army, while one or more CHARACTER models are leading that unit, you can re-roll Advance and Charge rolls made for it. If that CHARACTER model is a MAGUS, PRIMUS or ACOLYTE ICONWARD, that model has the Feel No Pain 3+ ability while leading that unit.
rule.flavor: Downtrodden by the oppressors for so long, a cult’s lowly broodkin are fanatically devoted to their leaders, for those hallowed individuals serve the Patriarchs will more directly. The masses draw upon energy reserves in their desire to heed their masters’ wishes, surging selflessly into the fray, ready to hurl themselves in harm’s way for the Patriarch’s chosen.
rule.name: Unquestioning Fanaticism

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, improve the Attacks and Weapon Skill characteristics of melee weapons equipped by models (excluding CHARACTERS) in your unit by 1 and those weapons have the [HAZARDOUS] ability.
stratagems.flavor: The faithful will gladly hurl themselves into harm's way.frenziedly dragging the foe down.
stratagems.name: Frenzied Devotion
stratagems.target: One Acolyte Hybrids, Hybrid Metamorphs or Neophyte Hybrids unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.when: Fight phase.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the battle, each time a friendly Acolyte Hybrids, Hybrid Metamorphs or Neophyte Hybrids model makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, re-roll a Hit roll of 1. If the destroyed model was a Magus, Primus or Acolyte Iconward, you can re-roll the Hit roll instead.
stratagems.flavor: Should one of the Patriarch's inner coven fall, those that remain are swift to call for lethal retribution.
stratagems.name: Vengeance for the Martyr!
stratagems.target: One other GENESTEALER CULTS CHARACTER model from your army.
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit destroys a GENESTEALER CULTS CHARACTER model from your army.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, you can set up your unit on the battlefield without using a Cult Ambush marker. When doing so, set up your unit anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy units.
stratagems.flavor: Such is the creed's inspirational call to arms that as the foe foil one incursion, another rises for the cause.
stratagems.name: The Downtrodden Rise
stratagems.target: One Acolyte Hybrids, Hybrid Metamorphs or Neophyte Hybrids unit from your army in Cult Ambush.
stratagems.when: End of your opponent’s Movement phase.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [ASSAULT] ability.
stratagems.flavor: Owing to their hypersensory reactions, the cult’s rate of fire increases.
stratagems.name: Transcendent Celerity
stratagems.target: One Acolyte Hybrids, Hybrid Metamorphs or Neophyte Hybrids unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.

stratagems.effect:
▪ If your unit made an advance/**[gloss:fall-back-move:fall-back move]** this turn, that advance/**fall-back move** does not prevent your unit from being **[gloss:eligible-to-charge:eligible to declare a charge]**.
▪ When your unit **[gloss:declare-charge:declares a charge]**, you can use this part of this **[gloss:stratagem:Stratagem]**. If you do:
▪ Your unit can re-roll **[gloss:charge-roll:Charge rolls]**.
▪ Your unit __must__ end that charge move engaged with an enemy unit engaged with a friendly CHARACTER unit.
stratagems.flavor: When the cult's leaders demand devotion, danger and exhaustion are forgotten in the rush to serve.
stratagems.name: Tireless Fervour
stratagems.target: One Acolyte Hybrids, Hybrid Metamorphs or Neophyte Hybrids unit from your army that has not declared a charge this phase.
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase.

stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a move of up to D6", but it unit must end that move as close as possible to the closest enemy unit (excluding AIRCRAFT), When doing so, models in your unit can be moved within Engagement Range of that enemy unit.
stratagems.flavor: Bloody persecution by the oppressors is grist for the mill of the cult's violent and zealous creed.
stratagems.name: The Path of Anguish
stratagems.target: One Acolyte Hybrids or Neophyte Hybrids unit from your army that had one or more of its models destroyed as a result of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.

enhancements.body: LOCUS/SANCTUS model only. This model’s attacks have +1 D.
enhancements.flavor: Years of experimentation and stolen biodata have gone into the fabrication of these unique and horrible toxins, which are now used to coat the weapons of the cult’s favoured champions.
enhancements.name: Gene-tailored Toxins

enhancements.body: KELERMORPH/REDUCTUS SABOTEUR model only. This unit’s ranged attacks have +2 S.
enhancements.flavor: Carefully husbanded against the Day of Ascension, these rare and powerful black-market rounds are issued only to the cult’s finest marksmen.
enhancements.name: Contraband Munitions

rule.body:
▪ Friendly KELERMORPH/LOCUS/REDUCTUS SABOTEUR/SANCTUS models have KILLER.
▪ Friendly KILLER models’ attacks can:
▪ Re-roll Hit rolls of 1.
▪ Re-roll Wound rolls of 1.
rule.flavor: What passes for folk heroism amongst the deviants of the Genestealer Cults is part broodmind compulsion and unwilling worship, and part these champions’ ability to commit deeds of great and terrible violence against any who stand in the way of the cult.
rule.name: Killer Reputation

stratagems.effect: Each **[gloss:visible:visible]** friendly **[gloss:battle-shocked:Battle-shocked]** GENESTEALER CULTS unit within 12" of your unit is no longer **Battle-shocked**.
stratagems.flavor: Few sights are more inspiring to the downtrodden yet fanatical masses of the Genestealer Cult than seeing their folk heroes striking down their oppressors.
stratagems.name: Living Up to Legend
stratagems.target: That KILLER unit.
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly KILLER unit has attacked, if those attacks **[gloss:destroyed:destroyed]** an enemy unit or an enemy CHARACTER model.

stratagems.effect: Attacks made by KILLER models in your unit have [DEVASTATING WOUNDS].
stratagems.flavor: Feeding back through the unnatural connection of the broodmind, the sheer worshipful belief of the masses in the superhuman abilities of their champions actually manifests to empower those very figureheads.
stratagems.name: Surging Broodworship
stratagems.target: That KILLER unit.
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly KILLER unit is **[gloss:selected-to-attack:selected to attack]**.

stratagems.effect:
When a KILLER model in your unit is **[gloss:destroyed:destroyed]**, if your unit has not been **[gloss:selected-to-fight:selected to fight]** this phase, roll one D6:
▪ On a 1, that enemy unit suffers 1 **[gloss:mortal-wound:mortal wound]**.
▪ On a 2+, do not remove that model from the battlefield. When your unit has fought, or at the end of the phase (whichever comes first), that model is removed from the battlefield.
stratagems.flavor: Even caught firmly within the jaws of death, still this champion of the cult lives up to their reputation for deadly skill and utter devotion to the cause.
stratagems.name: Loyal to the End
stratagems.target: That KILLER unit.
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly KILLER unit.

enhancements.body:
PURESTRAIN GENESTEALERS unit only. This unit has:
▪ +1 T.
▪ 4+ Sv.
▪ This unit’s melee attacks have +1 S.
enhancements.flavor: Spontaneous biomorphs amongst this brood of Purestrains render them bigger, stronger, and mark them out as surely being the chosen of the Star Children themselves.
enhancements.name: Mark of the Star Children

enhancements.body: PATRIARCH model only. This unit’s attacks can re-roll Wound rolls of 1.
enhancements.flavor: The broodmind bond between this Patriarch and its Purestrain spawn is so strong that it can virtually wield them like its own vicious talons.
enhancements.name: Talons of the Sire

rule.body: At the end of your opponent’s Fight phase, friendly **[gloss:unengaged:unengaged]** PURESTRAIN GENESTEALER units can be placed in **[gloss:strategic-reserves:Strategic Reserves]**.
rule.flavor: Genestealers on the hunt combine malevolent cunning and inhuman agility to strike and fade again and again, until their prey are reduced to panicked disarray.
rule.name: Enemy Within

stratagems.effect: That move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to declare a charge.
stratagems.flavor: Any sign these vicious aliens are trying to flee is but misdirection as they slip away from their attackers only to pounce once again upon unsuspecting prey.
stratagems.name: Lurk and Strike
stratagems.target: That PURESTRAIN GENESTEALERS unit.
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly PURESTRAIN GENESTEALERS unit is selected to make a fall-back move.

stratagems.effect: Your unit has -6" **[gloss:detection-range:detection range]** until the end of the turn.
stratagems.flavor: Genestealers can constrict themselves into grotesquely narrow spaces, can crawl across vertical surfaces and hang from ceilings in utter silence, and are rarely seen by their prey before it is altogether too late.
stratagems.name: Crawling Horror
stratagems.target: One friendly PURESTRAIN GENESTEALERS unit.
stratagems.when: Start of your opponent’s Movement phase.

stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a **[gloss:normal-move:Normal move]** of up to D3+3".
stratagems.flavor: Purestrain Genestealers think and move with horrifying swiftness, darting through the smoke and shadow of the battlefield, remaining always a few steps ahead of their prey.
stratagems.name: Inhuman Reactions
stratagems.target: That PURESTRAIN GENESTEALERS unit.
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly **[gloss:unengaged:unengaged]** PURESTRAIN GENESTEALERS unit.

enhancements.body: MAGUS/PRIMUS model only. This unit’s attacks can re-roll **[gloss:damage-roll:Damage rolls]**.
enhancements.flavor: Fighting under the eyes of the very leaders of their cult, the faithful are gripped by an unwavering determination to excel in battle.
enhancements.name: Inspired to Greatness

enhancements.body: NEOPHYTE HYBRIDS unit only. This unit has -3" **[gloss:detection-range:detection range]**.
enhancements.flavor: Whether it be stolen uniforms, ad-hoc camouflage or even some chameleonic xenomutation, these Neophytes are able to blend into their surroundings.
enhancements.name: Devious Disguises

rule.body:
In your Command phase, if a friendly NEOPHYTE HYBRIDS unit is within a **[gloss:terrain-area:terrain area]**, that unit **[gloss:heal:heals]** 3 wounds.

This **[gloss:detachments:detachment]** has the **HOSTS** tag and cannot be taken with another **HOSTS** **detachment**.
rule.flavor: More and yet more Neophytes surge from tunnel mouths, mine entrances and derelict fortifications, drowning the foe in a tide of fanatical killers.
rule.name: Hordes of the Faithful

stratagems.effect: Enemy units within that **[gloss:terrain-area:terrain area]** have +6" **[gloss:detection-range:detection range]**.
stratagems.flavor: Equipped with a wealth of local knowledge, it is no great task for these Neophytes to make out the positions of the unbelievers and report their presence to the cult.
stratagems.name: Eyes of the Cult
stratagems.target: One friendly NEOPHYTE HYBRIDS unit within a **[gloss:terrain-area:terrain area]**.
stratagems.when: Start of your Shooting phase.

stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit. Your unit’s ranged attacks that target that enemy unit can re-roll Hit rolls.
stratagems.flavor: Driven wild with hate and fervour, the hybrids unleash a veritable storm of criss-crossing fire into their loathed foe.
stratagems.name: Fanatical Hail
stratagems.target: That NEOPHYTE HYBRIDS unit.
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly NEOPHYTE HYBRIDS unit is **[gloss:selected-to-shoot:selected to shoot]**.

stratagems.effect: Ranged attacks that target your unit have -1 AP until that unit has attacked.
stratagems.flavor: Used to being downtrodden, to creeping secretively through the shadows and hiding from authority, these Neophyte Hybrids are almost preternaturally skilled at making use of battlefield cover.
stratagems.name: Slunk from the Underbelly
stratagems.target: That NEOPHYTE HYBRIDS unit.
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly NEOPHYTE HYBRIDS unit with every model within a **[gloss:terrain-area:terrain area]**.
